name: Shackle Throw
description: Hurl a heavy shackle of qi that snaps shut on the foe's nearest limb.

name: Link Share
description: Share the force of a heavy blow along a chain of links so no one link bears it.

name: Binding Probe
description: Probe a great chain with a pulse of qi to find the link that carries its load.

name: Strand Rip
description: Rip a strand from a foe's binding and let the whole weave come undone.

name: Wrought Chain
description: Forge a chain of dense qi round a foe link by link and close it with a twist.

name: Tension Recoil
description: Stretch a chain to catch a blow and release it so the force rebounds on the striker.

name: Link Web
description: Spin a web of linked chains across a wide front that closes on all within.

name: Fetter Storm
description: Fling a storm of fetters outward that clamp every limb they strike.

name: Iron Dominion
description: Lay iron-hard bonds on a mighty foe so that body and qi are held together.

name: Sunder Link
description: Drive a lance of qi through the weakest link of a foe's guard and break the chain.

name: Tether Flash
description: Snap along a tether between two points so fast the eye loses the body between them.

name: Endless Chain
description: The school's own chain that keeps paying out links as the foe strains so the hold never runs short.

name: Worldbind
description: Chain every living thing across the field at once and crush those who strain to the destructive ceiling of a Xiantian binder.

name: Core Lashing
description: Lash a core-bright cord across a foe's guard and let it coil on the arm.

name: Bond Ward
description: Raise a ward on a bond shared with allies so blows on one are spread to all.

name: Far Reading
description: Read a bond from its far end to learn the condition of the one who holds it.

name: Tie Cutter
description: Cut a single tie with a stroke of core qi and unravel the foe's formation.

name: Core Chain
description: Draw a chain from the core and lay it round a foe too strong to cinch with cord.

name: Bond Rebound
description: Turn a blow aside along a living bond and return it to its source.

name: Core Lattice
description: Lay a lattice of core bonds over the ground that closes on any who cross it.

name: Binding Cyclone
description: Spin a cyclone of cords outward that snatches up each foe it reaches.

name: Core Fetter
description: Close a core fetter on a lone champion that holds body and qi alike.

name: Anchor Phase
description: Slip along the line of a bond through a foe's guard and out its far side.

name: Reaching Shackle
description: Pierce a distant foe's guard with a shackle that closes from within.

name: Unbreakable Tie
description: The school's own tie that the foe's strength cannot part and whose hold grows with the user's reserve.

name: Binding Cataclysm
description: Cast ties across a whole region and crush all caught in them to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier binder.

name: Total Fetter
description: Fetter every being in sight past all escape up to the ceiling of a Core-tier binder.
